Name: Global Preserves Jar Chest
Author: xx2918
Description:
Description

Global Preserves Jar Chest adds a craftable chest that supplies ingredients to vanilla Preserves Jars and collects their finished products. The chest and jars can be in different locations; they do not need to be adjacent. The jars use the game's normal recipes and processing times.

Installation instructions

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+. Download the 1.0.0 installation ZIP and extract its GlobalPreservesJarChest folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. Check that Mods/GlobalPreservesJarChest/manifest.json exists, then launch the game through SMAPI.

Main features

- Each chest has 70 slots shared by ingredients and finished products. You can place more than one chest.
- The recipe unlocks at Farming level 6. It costs 150 Wood, 50 Stone, 3 Copper Bars, 1 Iron Bar, and 10 Coal.
- Automation checks jars at the start of each day and every 10 in-game minutes by default.
- If every chest is full, finished products stay in their jars until space is available.
- The chest name, description, and recipe follow the game's English or Simplified Chinese language setting.

Requirements and compatibility

This mod handles vanilla Preserves Jars. It does not handle kegs, casks, or custom machines with different IDs. In multiplayer, the host runs automation; other players should install the same version.

The mod creates a config.json on first launch. SMAPI console commands are gpjc status, gpjc rescan, and gpjc give.
